d: Kya aapke bal pahle se zyada jhar rahe hain? kya nahate samay, kanghi karte vaqt ya takie par bal dekhkar aap bhi pareshan ho jate hain? aajkal Hair Fall aur Baldness sirf barhti umr ki samasya nahin rah gaee hai. 20-25 sal ke larke-larkiyan bhi isse pareshan hain. koee mahange Shampoos aur Hair Serums aazma raha hai, koee gharelu nuskhon par bharosa kar raha hai, to koee bina puri jankari ke Clinical Treatments aur Supplements le raha hai.
